requirement: Maintain an unreserved ZFS accounting floor in addition to tenant guarantees; block managed grants and global/cache growth that would consume it.

negative_control.fixture: 32 GiB scratch pool; two 12 GiB tenant reservations; 10 GiB VM roots
negative_control.observation: At zero root available space, VM B paused on QEMU BLOCK_IO_ERROR nospace=true despite >6 GiB available inside its tenant reservation.
negative_control.recovery: Restoring unreserved headroom and explicitly resuming the disposable VM allowed its writes to finish without changing its tenant reservation or disk size.

must_not_claim: An unused emergency-reserve dataset is equivalent to an unreserved accounting floor

implementation_required: Encode the unreserved operating floor in every pool-wide admission path. Size the production margin conservatively; 1 GiB is the tested 32 GiB fixture value, not a universal setting.
